Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that extracts vendor, date, total, and line-item fields from an invoice using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
from pdf4me.client.ui_client import UiClient

# Initialize the PDF4me client
client = UiClient(api_key='YOUR_API_KEY')

# Path to the invoice PDF file
invoice_path = 'path/to/invoice.pdf'

# Extract text from the invoice
text_result = client.pdf_extract_text(invoice_path)

# Extract structured data (vendor, date, total, line items) using OCR and PDF analysis
extracted_data = client.extraction_ocr_and_extract(invoice_path)

# Print the extracted information
print("Vendor:", extracted_data['vendor'])
print("Date:", extracted_data['date'])
print("Total:", extracted_data['total'])

# Iterate over line items and print details
for item in extracted_data['line_items']:
    print("Item:", item['description'])
    print("Quantity:", item['quantity'])
    print("Price:", item['price'])
    print("Total:", item['total'])
    print("---")
